text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?!
What's the matter all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, knowing that the time has finally come 
just made me too restless to sit still...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
B-But singing isn't right, is it? It takes 
stamina, too. *Sigh*—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Everyone in Tomakomai, I'll do my 
best."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, alright! I've calmed down a bit! 
Keep your eyes on me, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
As a locodol, and as Hokko Tarumae— I will 
run a race my hometown can be proud of!
